description: A corporate law firm's security manager has mandated that all visitor check-ins must capture complete information. Navigate to Jolly Lobby Track's settings or configuration area and locate the visitor form/field configuration section. Ensure that the following three fields are all set as REQUIRED (mandatory) for visitor check-in: (1) Company (or Company Name / Organization), (2) Phone (or Phone Number / Telephone), and (3) Purpose of Visit (or Reason for Visit / Visit Purpose). After configuring all three fields as required, save the changes. The Lobby Track application is already running on screen.
